messages:
ralph: noticed strange pending GPU pattern in eu-west1—many nodes show 1 free GPU but scheduler refuses placement
meera: same, pending small jobs spiking to ~45
diane: quick glance at scoring: nvlink_weight is high and node-scores for tiny pods are negative because of pv topology mismatches
sre-bot: ALERT: packing_efficiency<0.55 pending_gpu>40 region=eu-west1
ralph: can we temporarily lower nvlink weight and run a consolidation sweep?
meera: lowering nvlink weight from 18 -> 6 via configmap patch now
diane: kicking off consolidate: `./tools/consolidate-pods --sel app=tiny-gpu --region eu-west1 --apply --max-move 50`
ralph: consolidation moved 34 pods, reclaimed 20 GPUs, pending dropped to 8 :tada:
sre-bot: NOTE: autoscaler freeze enabled during consolidation to prevent oscillation
meera: follow-ups: add e2e test for pv+nvlink combos, metric nvlink_placement_failures_total, and a safe-feature-flag for relaxing nvlink constraints
diane: opening PRs for scheduler tests and runbook entries, will revert config after 2h if stable
